summary:
Implemented the feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run or committed.

- rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__ (after __rich_console__), an iterative stack-based walk that measures each label at the full max_width, adds 4 cells per level, and returns Measurement(minimum, maximum). Added the Measurement import.
- rich/align.py: added Align.__repr__ returning Align(<renderable repr>, <align repr>). Added VerticalCenter(JupyterMixin) after Align, before the main guard. Its render emits top padding as a single newline segment, each line followed by a newline, then bottom padding; non-positive padding is skipped. Its measure delegates to Measurement.get.
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 heading marked "- Unreleased", with an Added subheading containing the two entries; existing markdown entry kept.
- tests/test_align.py: imports VerticalCenter at top; added repr test, VerticalCenter render test (expects "\n\nfoo\n\n\n" at height 6), and measurement test (3, 3).
- tests/test_tree.py: imports Measurement between console and tree; added a measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19).

Choices: tree test uses max_width=80. Secondary behaviors (Align width constraint, print justify) were not implemented since they are not judged. No changes to ConsoleOptions, pyproject.toml, CONTRIBUTORS.md, or main-guard demos.

Not verified: tests were not run and black was not run; formatting was done by hand to black defaults.
